attribution.legal_posture: Named in a Republic of Korea unilateral sanctions designation or its official living sanctions list. The status is administrative; criminal charge and conviction status remain absent.

caveats: The dated designation announcement and the living sanctions list are two Republic of Korea Ministry of Foreign Affairs publications in one official source family; retain both for complementary claim-level support and treat them as one source family. The living-list citation establishes list presence and naming as accessed; current activity, location, role, and operational control require newer evidence.
Included regional primary sources print only Korean-script forms; the Latin-script field remains blank.
This record preserves the official source's stated role in an overseas IT delegation or related entity. Personal software-development work requires a separate source finding.

identity_boundary: 윤정식 is the Korean-script identity printed in Republic of Korea administrative sanctions materials for a source-described 313총국 Shenyang IT delegation head. The designation and stated rationale are administrative government actions; no criminal case or finding of guilt is recorded. Sources print the Korean-script form only. The subject stays separate from same-named South Korean politicians, broadcasting or telecom executives, scientists, professors, lawyers, journalists, or public accounts unless a source explicitly links them. Historical delegation and location descriptions provide context for the reported period; residence, present location, and current activity require separate source support.
